facts.fact: InforMEA records Decree No. 10/2025 of 28 March 2025 as approving the National Strategy for Digital Transformation for Guinea-Bissau 2025-2030 (ENTD.GW), aimed at a capable state energising the economy and an inclusive society.
facts.system: National Strategy for Digital Transformation for Guinea-Bissau 2025-2030 (ENTD.GW)

facts.fact: InforMEA's summary says the ENTD.GW breaks its vision into six strategic objectives and 55 interventions indexed to them, with no cost stated.
